description: Implementation of QueryGL classes and related query handling logic for OpenGL in the ANGLE project, including query result merging, query management, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: QueryGL
classes.description: Base class for OpenGL query objects.

classes.name: StandardQueryGL
classes.description: Handles standard OpenGL queries, including begin, end, result retrieval, and merging results.

classes.name: SyncQueryGL
classes.description: Handles synchronization queries, supporting fence sync and occlusion queries.

classes.name: SyncProviderGLSync
classes.description: Sync provider using GL fence sync objects.

methods.name: MergeQueryResults
methods.description: Merges two query results based on query type.

methods.name: QueryGL::QueryGL
methods.description: Constructor for QueryGL base class.

methods.name: QueryGL::~QueryGL
methods.description: Destructor for QueryGL base class.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::begin
methods.description: Starts the query, resetting result sum.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::end
methods.description: Ends the query.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::queryCounter
methods.description: Creates a timestamp query and adds it to pending queries.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::getResultBase
methods.description: Retrieves the accumulated query result.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::getResult
methods.description: Overloaded functions to get query result as different types.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if query results are available.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::pause
methods.description: Pauses the current query.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused query.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::flush
methods.description: Flushes pending queries and updates results.

methods.name: SyncProviderGL::flush
methods.description: Abstract method to flush sync provider.

methods.name: SyncProviderGLSync::flush
methods.description: Flush using fence sync object.

methods.name: SyncProviderGLQuery::flush
methods.description: Flush using occlusion query.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::begin
methods.description: Begins a sync query.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::end
methods.description: Ends a sync query, initializing sync provider.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the sync query.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the sync query result is available.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::flush
methods.description: Flushes the sync provider.
